The road has distinctive yellow border markings. (3) The woman stands in the middle of the road, looking back at the camera with a wide smile and gesturing toward the church with her hands out. The lighting is soft and natural daylight. (4) Aerial drone footage provides a high-angle view of the church, revealing its isolated position on a hill surrounded by brown and green fields, with a winding road leading to it. (5) The woman appears in a close-up shot, now wearing a vibrant red knitted sweater and a matching red beanie. She smiles brightly and adjusts her hair while looking at the camera, with the red-roofed church visible in the background over her shoulder. (6) She continues to walk and turn around on the road, exhibiting high-arousal happy facial expressions and fluid body movements.
